讀進資料

```{r echo=T, message=F, cache=F, warning=F}
#清空環境
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE))

#套件載入
pacman::p_load(
  vcd, magrittr, readr, caTools, ggplot2, tidyr, dplyr, plotly,
  reshape2, factoextra
)
#設定工作目錄
setwd("C:/retail-big-data-analysis-marketing")

#載入資料
load("data/dataset.rdata")

#查看資料列數
sapply(list(cust=A0,tid=X0,items=Z0), nrow)
```

1\. 篩選品類、計算回購率與連帶購買率

```{r}
#把年齡轉成數字（原本是a39/a49類型）
# 確保是文字
Z0$age <- as.character(Z0$age)
# 抓出數字
Z0 <- Z0 %>%
  mutate(age = parse_number(age))
# 查看結果
str(Z0$age)
head(Z0$age)

#產品層級彙總資料：不同產品數量、總銷量、總營收、總毛利、毛利率、平均售價、平均客戶年齡、客戶數
cats <- Z0 %>% 
  group_by(cat) %>% summarise(
  noProd = n_distinct(prod), 
  totalQty = sum(qty, na.rm = TRUE), 
  totalRev = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE), 
  totalGross = sum(price - cost, na.rm = TRUE), 
  grossMargin= totalGross / totalRev, 
  avgPrice = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE), 
  avgAge = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 
  nCust = n_distinct(cust), 
  .groups = "drop" )

#1.1 以營收篩選取Top40的品類top40
top40 <- cats %>% 
  arrange(desc(totalRev)) %>% 
  head(40)

#1.2 計算回購率repurchase_df

repurchase_df <- Z0 %>% 
  filter(cat %in% top40$cat) %>%
    #以品類cat、顧客cust分組，計算n_orders: 各品類下的訂單數
  group_by(cat, cust) %>% 
  summarise(n_orders = n_distinct(tid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  #按品類 cat 再分組，計算回購率 = 回購顧客數/總顧客數
  #n(): 該品類總顧客數
  #sum(n_orders > 1): 該品類中「有回購的顧客數」
  
  group_by(cat) %>% 
  summarise(repurchaseRate = sum(n_orders > 1) / n(), .groups = "drop")


#1.3 計算連帶購買率（一張訂單買超過1個品類）cross_df
#n_cat: 該訂單包含幾種不同品類
tid_cats <- Z0 %>%
  filter(cat %in% top40$cat) %>%
  group_by(tid) %>%
  summarise(n_cat = n_distinct(cat), .groups = "drop")

cross_df <- Z0 %>%
  filter(cat %in% top40$cat) %>% 
  #合併回原始資料欄
  left_join(tid_cats, by = "tid") %>%
  #標記哪些訂單是連帶購買訂單
  mutate(cross = n_cat > 1) %>% group_by(cat) %>% 
  
  #連帶購買率 = 有連帶購買的顧客數/買這個品類的所有顧客數
  #n_distinct(cust):買這個品類的所有顧客數
  #n_distinct(cust[cross]): 有連帶購買的顧客數
  summarise( crossBuyRate = n_distinct(cust[cross]) / n_distinct(cust), .groups = "drop" )

#1.4 整合資料
top40_all <- top40 %>%
  left_join(repurchase_df, by = "cat") %>% 
  left_join(cross_df, by = "cat")

```

2\. 帶入指標變數、做層級式分群

```{r}
#2.1 選變數、標準化、分群 (k = 4)

#要用來分群的變數(品類特徵)
vars <- c("totalRev","grossMargin","avgPrice","avgAge","repurchaseRate","crossBuyRate")

# 取出這些變數並做標準化 (Z-score)
top40_scaled <- scale(top40_all[, vars]) 

# 把品類名稱設為 row names（方便 dendrogram 顯示）
row.names(top40_scaled) <- top40_all$cat

# 計算品類之間的距離 (Euclidean distance)，距離越小特徵越相似
dist_mat <- dist(top40_scaled, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "ward.D2")



#2.2 做層級式分群 (hierarchical clustering)

#分成4群
k <- 4 

# 畫樹狀圖
plot(hc, hang = -1, main = "營收Top40產品- 層級式集群樹狀圖") 

# 在圖上畫出4群
rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = "red")

# 將分群結果加入資料表
top40_all$cluster <- cutree(hc, k = k)



#2.3 群組摘要: 計算每一群的平均特性 cluster_summary
cluster_summary <- top40_all %>% group_by(cluster) %>% summarise(across(all_of(vars), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

#2.4 標準化群組摘要 (for圖表視覺呈現) cluster_scaled
cluster_scaled <- cluster_summary
cluster_scaled[, vars] <- scale(cluster_summary[, vars])
```

3\. 製圖：互動圖A、互動圖B

```{r}
#3.1 A：互動圖（群組×所有指標，群組在 X 軸）

#melt()：把寬表格轉成長表，以利畫圖
dfm <- melt(cluster_scaled, id.vars = "cluster")

#X軸: 群組1-4
#Y軸: 標準化後的指標值
#hover: 滑鼠移上去會顯示「群組 + 指標名稱 + Z-score」
#barmode = "group"：同一群組的不同指標條形並列，以利比較
p_main <- plot_ly( 
  data = dfm, 
  x = ~factor(cluster), 
  y = ~value, 
  color = ~variable, 
  colors = "Set2", 
  type = "bar", 
  hovertemplate = paste( 
    "分群: %{x}<br>", 
    "指標: %{color}<br>", 
    "Z-score: %{y:.2f}<extra></extra>" ) ) %>% 
  
  #設定整張圖的版面和標題layout
  layout( 
    barmode = "group", 
    title = paste0("營收Top40產品-群組特性比較（標準化、k=", k, "，可互動）"), 
    xaxis = list(title = paste0("分群 (k=", k, ")")), 
    yaxis = list(title = "標準化分數 (Z-score)", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "black"), 
    legend = list(title = list(text = "指標"))
    )

#顯示互動圖
p_main 



#3.2 互動圖 B：四張細分圖（每個群組單獨圖，更清楚看到六個指標）

# 指標順序（顯示順序用）
vars <- c("totalRev","grossMargin","avgPrice","avgAge","repurchaseRate","crossBuyRate")

# 整理：把「標準化後」與「原始平均值」都攤平成長表，之後合併
# 標準化後的值 (Z-score)
#pivot_longer():把寬表格（每個指標一欄）改成長表格（每行一個群組），以利plotly 畫圖
df_z <- cluster_scaled %>% select(cluster, all_of(vars)) %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "z")

# 原始平均值
df_raw <- cluster_summary %>% select(cluster, all_of(vars)) %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "raw")

# 合併
df_long <- df_z %>% left_join(df_raw, by = c("cluster","variable")) %>% mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = vars))

# 小工具：畫「單一群組」的互動條圖
mk_cluster_panel <- function(cl){ 
  dat <- df_long %>% filter(cluster == cl) 
  
  plot_ly( data = dat, 
           x = ~variable, 
           y = ~z, 
           type = "bar", 
           color = ~variable, 
           colors = "Set2", 
           hovertemplate = paste( 
             "群組: ", cl, "<br>", 
             "指標: %{x}<br>", 
             "Z-score: %{y:.2f}<br>", 
             "原始平均: %{customdata}<extra></extra>" ),
           customdata = round(dat$raw, 3) ) %>% 
    
    #customdata → hover 顯示原始平均值
    #showlegend = FALSE → 每張圖不顯示圖例
    layout(
      title = paste0("群組 ", cl, "｜六指標對比（標準化）"), 
      xaxis = list(title = NULL), 
      yaxis = list(title = "Z-score", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "black"), 
      showlegend = FALSE ) }

# 生成所有群組的面板
# 取得群組編號
clusters <- sort(unique(df_long$cluster)) 
# 各群組生成一張圖
plots <- lapply(clusters, mk_cluster_panel)

# 依群數自動算出要排版幾列（算總共有4個群組，每列放2張圖），向上取整數ceiling
nrows <- ceiling(length(plots) / 2) 

plot_ly(
  data = dfm,
  x = ~factor(cluster),
  y = ~value,
  color = ~variable,
  type = "bar"
) %>%
layout(
  barmode = "group",
  title = "營收Top40產品-群組特性比較"
)
```
